extracted.intended_audience: Brown University investigators, faculty, and researchers (including staff involved in proposal development and research administration)
extracted.subtask_description: Overview page describing the Division of Research's role in supporting Brown investigators through the research lifecycle, including proposal development, funding identification, contracting, compliance, IP protection, and technology transfer.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support investigators at every stage of the research cycle
rubrics_metrics.description: The Division of Research fosters research, scholarship, collaboration and creative endeavors at the University by supporting its investigators and scholars at every stage of their research cycle.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides comprehensive and strategic advocacy for researchers, connecting them to critical resources inside and outside Brown and supporting individuals and teams throughout every step of their research endeavors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Develop initial research strategies
rubrics_metrics.description: Partnering with researchers to develop initial research strategies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Helps researchers frame projects and plan research directions early in the process to position proposals for success.

rubrics_metrics.name: Identify funding opportunities
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assist investigators in finding relevant internal and external funding mechanisms and aligning project aims with funder priorities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submit proposals
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Support in preparing and submitting grant and contract proposals, reducing barriers to timely and compliant submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Negotiate contracts
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide institutional assistance in negotiating terms with sponsors to protect institutional and investigator interests.

rubrics_metrics.name: Establish funding structures
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Help set up the appropriate account, budgeting, and administrative frameworks to manage awards effectively.

rubrics_metrics.name: Guide technology transfer
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Support commercialization of research outputs, including IP evaluation and pathways to market.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support startup ventures
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assist researchers in translating innovations into startup companies and provide related institutional resources.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reduce administrative workload for researchers
rubrics_metrics.description: Reduce the administrative workload for Brown researchers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Aim to make the research process less complex by taking on administrative tasks related to proposal development, awards management, and compliance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Protect intellectual property
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide guidance and services to identify, protect, and manage IP arising from research.

rubrics_metrics.name: Manage conflicts of interest
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure appropriate disclosure and management plans to handle potential or actual conflicts involving researchers and research activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ensure integrity of research
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Support practices and policies that promote honest, rigorous, and ethical research conduct.

rubrics_metrics.name: Maintain compliance with state and federal regulations
rubrics_metrics.description: Maintain compliance with state and federal regulations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide resources and oversight to ensure research activities and funded projects meet applicable legal and regulatory requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Increase external funding of research at Brown
rubrics_metrics.description: Increase external funding of research at Brown.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Position investigators and proposals to be more competitive for federal and other external funding through strategic support and resources.

rubrics_metrics.name: Keep investigators informed of policies, procedures, and resources
rubrics_metrics.description: Stay informed about policies, procedures, and guidelines for conducting research; discover emerging resources and review important announcements from the Division of Research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Maintain communications (announcements, news, events) and a calendar of research-focused conferences, talks, and networking opportunities to engage the research community.
